title: Accounts
description: User accounts grouping identities of the same site; bans and disables apply to every member identity
noNamespace: Select a namespace to see its accounts.

empty.title: No accounts yet
empty.description: Accounts are created by imports with an _account column, by attaching identities or here.
empty.filteredDescription: No account matches the current filters.

operationHints.ban_one: Bans the account and removes its {{count}} identity from scheduling.
operationHints.ban_other: Bans the account and removes its {{count}} identities from scheduling.
operationHints.unban_one: Lifts the account ban; its {{count}} identity can be scheduled again.
operationHints.unban_other: Lifts the account ban; its {{count}} identities can be scheduled again.
operationHints.cooldown_one: Pauses leasing of the account's {{count}} identity for the duration.
operationHints.cooldown_other: Pauses leasing of the account's {{count}} identities for the duration.
operationHints.disable_one: Disables the account and its {{count}} identity until enabled again.
operationHints.disable_other: Disables the account and its {{count}} identities until enabled again.
operationHints.enable_one: Enables the account and its {{count}} identity.
operationHints.enable_other: Enables the account and its {{count}} identities.
